collection.description: A villager who eats exactly the same breakfast every day is offered a warm, sticky little cake.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: For as long as anyone can remember, (subject) has eaten exactly the same breakfast: half a coconut, three slices of fruit, and a handful of nuts, eaten in that order. This morning (friend) offers (subject.him/her) something new, a warm, sticky little cake (friend.he/she) made at dawn. It smells wonderful. It is not half a coconut.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) takes a careful bite. Then another. Then the whole thing is gone. "That," (subject.he/she) says, "was very good." (friend) beams. (subject) then eats half a coconut, three slices of fruit and a handful of nuts, in that order, because the cake was lovely but breakfast is breakfast.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: "It smells wonderful," (subject) says, "but I'll stick with mine, thank you." (friend) shrugs and eats the cake (friend.him/her)self, making a lot of happy noises about it. (subject) does not regret (subject.his/her) decision. Mostly. By lunchtime (subject.he/she) is still thinking about the cake.
